unsupported_claims: DeepWalk uses skip-gram with hierarchical softmax (evidence only shows a binary tree and SkipGram, not explicitly hierarchical softmax)
The frequency distribution of vertices visited by short random walks follows a power law similar to word frequencies (not in provided evidence)
rationale: The core claims (vertices as words, truncated random walks as sentences, skip-gram embeddings, window co-occurrence) are supported by the evidence. The power-law claim is not in the excerpts, though it is a real finding of the paper. Hierarchical softmax is only implied by the binary tree in Algorithm 1, so it is a minor addition.
